'''Scalchop Island''' (Japanese: '''ホタチ島''' ''{{tt|Hotachi|Scalchop}} Island'') is the second island {{Ash}}, {{an|Iris}}, and {{an|Cilan}} visited during their travels through the [[Decolore Islands]]. The island was formed by the accumulation of seashells and is distinctly [[Scalchop and seamitar|scalchop]] shaped.

The island hosts the annual [[Scalchop King Competition]], concerning {{p|Oshawott}} and its evolved forms. On the island, [[Ash's Oshawott]] fell in love with a [[female]] Oshawott, [[nickname]]d Osharina, who was the winner of the females division of the competition. In order to get her attention, Ash's Oshawott entered the tournament, gaining a rivalry with a Dewott nicknamed Caesar, owned by [[Cadbury|another Trainer]]. Ash and Oshawott eventually won the competition, but were disqualified after Oshawott's scalchop broke because he was heartbroken when he saw Osharina preferred Caesar over him. After that, Ash and {{ashfr}} left the island.
